quests.title: The Old Pushcart
quests.summary: The family shop is struggling. Help pay the rent by Day 7.

steps.text: Ask Grandpa about his old pushcart (front yard).
Buy stock at Lin's Wholesale (down the road, on the left).
Sell something at the pushcart in the park.
Save 50 coins and give them to Dad for the rent (by Day 7).

quests.title: A Stall of Our Own
quests.summary: The Summer Festival is on Day 14. Rent a market stall and sell there on the big day!

steps.text: Find the market square (walk east along the road).
Talk to Mr. Okafor outside the Market Office.
Save up and rent a market stall from Mr. Okafor.
Sell at your stall on Festival Day (Day 14).

quests.title: Market Rivals
quests.summary: Kofi thinks your stall is stealing his customers.

steps.text: Sort things out with Kofi. (What is he really worried about?)

quests.title: The Grumpy Customer
quests.summary: Mrs. Grumble is NOT happy with your lemonade.

steps.text: Help Mrs. Grumble calm down.

quests.title: Partners!
quests.summary: You and Dad run the corner shop together now. Make it shine before the Grand Reopening on Day 28.

steps.text: Open the Corner Shop (use its door) and sell something.
Invest in an upgrade for the shop (ask Dad at the door).
Celebrate the Grand Reopening on Day 28.

quests.title: The Big Fridge
quests.summary: Cold drinks sell better and keep longer. But a fridge costs 80 coins.

steps.text: Ask Dad how you could pay for a fridge.
Get the fridge: save up, or borrow from the Town Bank (market square).

quests.title: Price War
quests.summary: MegaMart is selling lemonade for just 2 coins.

steps.text: Keep your customers without cutting prices (hint: quality, not price).

quests.title: Straight from the Farm
quests.summary: Green Hill Farm grows things you can't buy in town.

steps.text: Find Green Hill Farm (walk west along the road).
Meet Farmer Ama.
Buy something at the Farm Shop.

quests.title: Two Shops
quests.summary: An empty shop in Riverside City could become your second shop - if you can afford it and find a manager.

steps.text: Take the bus to Riverside City (bus stop outside MegaMart).
Talk to Mrs. Osei about the empty shop.
Rent the city shop and choose a manager.
Show your business at the Young Business Fair (Day 42).

quests.title: Buying in Bulk
quests.summary: The City Market gives a lower price if you buy 20 or more of one thing.

steps.text: Meet Mr. Haddad at the City Market.
Buy 20 or more of one item at the bulk price.

quests.title: Hurt Feelings
quests.summary: A friend who wasn't chosen as manager feels left out.

steps.text: Talk to your friend and help them feel valued.

quests.title: Roots & Wings
quests.summary: A new generation, an old pushcart. Learn the family's story and give something back to the town.

steps.text: Sell something at the old pushcart with Nia.
Hear Aunt Maya's story (market square).
Visit Great-Grandpa at Green Hill Farm.
Choose a festival project with your parent.
Give 40 coins to your project before the 100th Festival (Day 14).

quests.title: Rainy Days
quests.summary: Bad days come to every business. Will you be ready when the storm comes?

steps.text: Talk to your parent about planning for bad days.
Get through the storm.
Get the pushcart working again (the repair costs 30 coins).

quests.title: A Standing Order
quests.summary: Baker Rosa wants 10 lemonade every three days. A promise is part of your reputation.

steps.text: Take Baker Rosa 10 lemonade on each delivery day (3 deliveries).

quests.title: Nia's Secret
quests.summary: The cart money doesn't add up. Nia has been giving things away.

steps.text: Find out why Nia did it, and decide together what to do.

quests.title: The New Kid
quests.summary: A boy sits alone on a park bench every day.

steps.text: Help Leo feel welcome. (Try listening first.)

quests.title: Too Good To Be True
quests.summary: A smiling man near the park has an amazing deal.

steps.text: Decide what to do about Smiley Steve's offer.
